# Requirements Specialist Skill

## Goals

- Convert the source brief into testable requirements.
- Surface ambiguity before drafting.
- Leave downstream architecture and QA teams with clear acceptance criteria.

## Checklist

- Summarize the source story before drafting.
- Separate confirmed facts from assumptions.
- Write acceptance criteria in behavior-focused language.
- Preserve unanswered questions explicitly.
